name: claude-gauge
description: Claude Code quota + live context window in the status bar — session/weekly usage, per-chat context %, multi-chat tracking, resume closed chats, daily token stats.

commands.title: Claude Usage: Pick Chat to Track
Claude Usage: Open Detailed View Beside Terminal
Claude Usage: Open Detailed View in New Terminal

claudeUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often to poll the Anthropic usage endpoint, in seconds. The endpoint is strictly rate-limited, so keep this high (default 10 min).

claudeUsage.credentialsPath.description: Optional override path to .credentials.json. Defaults to ~/.claude/.credentials.json.

claudeUsage.autoRefreshToken.description: When enabled, the extension renews an expired Claude access token itself and writes the rotated tokens back to .credentials.json (the same file Claude Code uses). Leave OFF to never modify your login file — if the token expires, the extension simply shows 'sign in' until Claude Code refreshes it.

claudeUsage.showDailyStats.description: Show today's total tokens and estimated API-price value in the tooltip (computed locally from transcripts).

claudeUsage.showContextWindow.description: Show the active Claude Code chat's context-window usage (read locally from ~/.claude/projects transcripts — no extra API calls).

claudeUsage.contextWindowTokens.description: Context window size in tokens used to compute the percentage. 0 = auto by model family (200k / 500k / 1M). Set explicitly (e.g. 500000) if your plan's window differs — check with /context in Claude Code.

claudeUsage.contextNotifyAt.description: Warn when the active chat's context crosses these percentages (so you can /compact in time). Set to [] to disable.

claudeUsage.notifyAt.description: Show a warning notification when session or weekly usage crosses these percentages. Set to [] to disable notifications.
